scoring_justification: Headline quantities (peak pressure, void stats) are derived from full MD simulation that cannot be re-run inside the verifier; compare agent's reported numbers against paper gold with tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold values for peak pressures and void statistics
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper Fig. 7a and text: peak pressures 1.6, 1.9, 2.3 GPa for intensities 597, 797, 996 GW/cm²; void statistics from text: 11 large voids, max diameter 47.6 nm at 198 ps, void volume fraction 0.055 (approximate read from Fig. 8)
hidden_assets.generation_method: extracted from paper's specific reported numbers and graphs
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: these are the actual paper-reported values used as reference gold

outputs.description: Peak volumetric pressures under 597, 797, and 996 GW/cm² intensities.
Number of large voids (diameter ≥ 10 nm), maximum diameter, and void volume fraction at 200 ps for the 996 GW/cm² case.

output_contract.notes: The hidden verifier compares the reported peak pressures and void statistics against the paper's published values, using permissive tolerances that reflect legitimate implementation spread.
